# Hector

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 ch.Last P28](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0028), [v5 CHAPTER XIV. MRS. HECTOR TWISS MAKES A CALL P12](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0012)</sub>
- **Role:** beacon tender (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 27 ON THE SAND BAR P1](../source/v04-c27.md#nw-v04-c27-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Elizabeth Russell](../character/elizabeth-russell.md) (sibling), [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md) (relative)

## Appearance

Hector possesses the finest looks, complemented by lovely, dark, curly hair.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P54](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0054)_

## Personality

Hector is an honorable and pleasant young man. He also possesses a strong understanding of the beacon.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P54](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0054), [v3 ch.Yesterday P0](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 6 CAPTAIN SAUL P19](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0019)_

## Goals

_Not yet known._

## History

Hector is the brother of Miss [Elizabeth Russell](../character/elizabeth-russell.md) and was married by his wife through a process he never fully understood. He stayed at [Mount Holly](../codex/places.md#mount-holly) alongside [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md), and [Orlando](../character/orlando.md). Later, Hector Ward arrived at [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside) to inform [Thora](../character/thora.md) that John Fairlie's mother was dying.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Yesterday P0](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0000), [v3 ch.Yesterday P4](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0004), [v3 ch.Yesterday P15](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0015), [v3 ch.Yesterday P20](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0020), [v3 ch.Last P12](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0012), [v3 ch.Last P25](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0025), +4 more_
